healthy.diagnostico: Healthy Crop - No signs of disease
healthy.accion: Continue routine monitoring. Maintain preventive measures.
tecnicas_nucleares: Radioisotopic mapping to evaluate nutrient use efficiency
Stable marker analysis (13C, 15N) in leaf tissue

Cercospora leaf spot Gray leaf spot.diagnostico: Cercospora Infection - Circular leaf spots with gray halos
Cercospora leaf spot Gray leaf spot.accion: Apply copper fungicide or triazoles. Remove infected leaves. Improve ventilation.
tecnicas_nucleares: Isotopic mapping with 32P for phosphorus uptake tracking
Marker analysis in affected tissue to determine severity
recomendaciones_tecnologicas: Dose: 750-1000 mL/ha in 200-300 L of water
Apply every 7-10 days based on rain conditions
Avoid sprinkler irrigation during sunlight hours

Common rust.diagnostico: Common Corn Rust - Orange pustules on leaves
Common rust.accion: Apply systemic fungicide. Use resistant varieties in next planting.
tecnicas_nucleares: Isotopic measurement of nutrient translocation rate in infected plants
15N analysis to assess impact on nitrogen uptake
recomendaciones_tecnologicas: Select varieties resistant to prevalent races

Northern Leaf Blight.diagnostico: Northern Leaf Blight - Elongated brown/black lesions
Northern Leaf Blight.accion: Apply preventive fungicide. Improve drainage. Remove infected residue.
tecnicas_nucleares: Radioisotope mapping to evaluate water distribution in tissue
Isotopic respiration analysis in damaged tissue
recomendaciones_tecnologicas: Destroy crop residue from previous harvest
